477. Counting Filled Buckets

Problem Statement:
A man has n buckets. He travels all the bucket and fills the water in bucket which is empty and empty the bucket which is already filled he goes for n times in this manner On first go 1,2,3,4,5,...n On second go 2,4,6,8... On third go 3,6,9... Your task is to develop a suitable algorithm in order to find the number of buckets which are filled with water at the end of last go. NOTE: INITIALLY ASSUME EVERY BUCKET IS EMPTY
input_spec: First line of test case contains a positive number. Which means that there are these many buckets.
output_spec: Print the number of buckets which are still having water.
